hiring.name: Employee Hiring & Onboarding
hiring.description: Full workflow from position approval, HR budgeting, candidate document submission, to infrastructure and initial onboarding.
hiring.step1Desc: Validation of financial availability and hiring urgency.
hiring.step2Desc: Posting on recruitment channels and resume screening.
hiring.step3Desc: Technical and behavioral interviews with leadership.
hiring.step4Desc: Awaiting submission of ID, Work Permit, and Medical Exam by the new employee.
hiring.step5Desc: Laptop procurement and credential creation across company tools.
hiring.step6Desc: Team introduction, initial training, and equipment delivery.

company.name: Business Formation & Incorporation
company.description: Complete process including prior feasibility check, articles of organization, registry bodies, and tax regime selection.
company.step1Desc: Validation at the Commercial Board and City Hall for address usage and business name approval.
company.step2Desc: Defining business purpose, share capital, equity distribution among partners, and legal clauses.
company.step3Desc: Digital submission of legal documents and automatic generation of the Federal Tax ID.
company.step4Desc: Application for operation license, fire department inspection (if required), and final permit issuance.
company.step5Desc: Filing for tax regime enrollment at the Revenue Service portal.
